resources.string: An accessibility remote for Pixel Camera. Press START on your Forerunner to take a photo without reaching for the phone\'s shutter.
Next step: allow nearby devices and notifications.
Next step: connect your watch in Garmin Connect and install Shutter Click on it.
Open Pixel Camera in Photo mode, then press START on the watch.
Pixel Camera is not installed. Shutter Click works only with Pixel Camera on Google Pixel phones.
Shutter Click recognizes the Pixel Camera shutter only when the phone language is English. With another language the watch shows Check camera.
Keep the phone unlocked with Pixel Camera visible in Photo mode. On the watch, press START or tap SHOOT. BACK exits the watch app.
The first camera profile recognizes English photo-shutter labels. Unknown controls stay disabled until verified.

Shutter Click is an accessibility tool for people who find it hard to reach or press the phone's camera shutter.

It uses an Android Accessibility service to look at Pixel Camera's on-screen controls and press its Photo shutter when you ask for a photo from your watch. It acts only during a remote session that you start, and only in Pixel Camera. It does not read other apps, your photos, or the camera image, and it collects no data.

You can turn the service off at any time in Android Accessibility settings.
